name: waluigi-wah-desk
description: Fast, bounded local archive chatbot with concurrent reads, saved local chat rooms, multimodal image context, safe Python analysis, focused edits, audits, and local image jobs.
lm_studio_timeout: -1 means no socket deadline; the UI cancel endpoint remains available.

creation_mode.room_checkpoints: browser-local draft transcript every five player messages
creation_mode.target_year_cutoff: future event records are filtered before UI display, retrieval, and image discovery
creation_mode.roleplay: short, snappy, personality-led, player agency preserved

tools.name: parallel_read
tools.side_effects: none; up to 12 bounded files concurrently

tools.name: parallel_search
tools.side_effects: none; up to 8 focused searches concurrently

tools.name: catalog_retrieve
tools.side_effects: none; returns focused canonical records with target-year cutoff

tools.name: analyze_event_seeds
tools.side_effects: none; identifies cleanup and roleplay candidates

tools.name: create_commentary
tools.side_effects: allowlisted commentary object; explicit approval and audit required

tools.name: python_analyze
tools.side_effects: offline analysis only; no imports, filesystem, network, subprocess, or writes

tools.name: repo_patch
tools.side_effects: one exact-match repository patch; explicit approval required

tools.name: repo_add_object
tools.side_effects: allowlisted canonical JSON object; explicit approval and audit required

tools.name: queue_image
tools.side_effects: local ComfyUI image job; explicit approval required
